title: fix(spec): the blueprint field's `expression` describe teaches the stored computed value (#32614)
body:
Fixes #32614
domain:spec#2 · sunhaolin · session_017xRBcSbLCxEmyHf9upz3pz (dev branch `claude/issue-32614-blueprint-expression-describe`)

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:AI 方案蓝图里字段 `expression` 的两段说明(宽松 schema 与设计模型实际读的 strict 镜像)改为同一套话,讲清两种用法:`formula` 读时计算、不可合计;同一个 `expression` 放在返回值类型的字段(`number` / `currency` / `percent` / `date`)上,就是写入时计算并落库的值,可以 `sum` / `avg`。
- 为什么改:旧说明告诉设计模型"非 formula 字段一律 null",所以 AI 搭建器把「销售额 = 销量 × 单价」建成 formula,之后所有合计都被拒。按 #32443 裁决 B,要合计的值应是带同一 `expression` 的落库字段。
- 风险与回滚:只改说明文字,schema 形状不变(两个 schema 原本就接受非 formula 字段带 `expression`)。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/spec/src/ai/solution-blueprint.zod.ts` 新增的 `FORMULA_STORAGE_RULE` / `STORED_EXPRESSION_RULE` 两个常量(两段 describe 共用,保证同步);`packages/spec/src/ai/solution-blueprint.test.ts` 末尾新 describe 块。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/ai/solution-blueprint.test.ts`,预期 103 个测试全绿。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- `BlueprintFieldSchema.expression` and `StrictField.expression` (the strict mirror the design model generates against) now end on the same two shared rules, so they cannot drift:
  - `FORMULA_STORAGE_RULE`: a `formula` is computed on read and stored nowhere; a list cannot sort by it, search does not scan it, and a `sum` / `avg` over it is refused with the remedy sentence. The sentence is `VIRTUAL_FIELD_AGGREGATE_REMEDY` (`packages/spec/src/data/aggregate-field-type-compatibility.ts`, PR #32545), carried verbatim.
  - `STORED_EXPRESSION_RULE`: the same `expression` on a field of the value's own return type (`number` / `currency` / `percent`, `date`, never `formula`) is a stored computed value, computed on every write and kept in a column, so `sum` / `avg` and sort work. Name the return type: a date expression on a `number` field is refused at every write. Per ruling 6816315099 on #32443, a stored expression reads only the record's own fields. A related-record value stays a `formula` or comes through a `summary` or a flow, and an input that changes over time is frozen at the write. Neither describe gives a stored example that reads through a lookup or reads the clock.
  - The closing line "null for every other field type" becomes: null (strict) / omit (lenient) on a field that is neither a formula nor a stored computed value.
- The existing formula text stays: one-hop lookup read, runtime-dead without the key, the `nameField` note, and the composed-title example the lint pin reads.
- No shape change, so the accept-set is unchanged.
- Why the remedy sentence is spelled out and not imported: importing `aggregate-field-type-compatibility.ts` into the blueprint module pulls `data/query.zod.ts` into the published `objectstack-ai` skill's reference index (`gen:skill-refs` rewrote `skills/objectstack-ai/references/_index.md`). That is a governed `skills/**` path, and the only reason would have been a describe string. The new test imports the constant and pins that both describes contain it verbatim.
- Regenerated: `content/docs/references/ai/solution-blueprint.mdx` (`gen:docs`). Nothing else went stale: `check:generated` reports 14/14 up to date.

## Tests

`packages/spec/src/ai/solution-blueprint.test.ts`, new top-level describe `blueprint field \`expression\` — the stored computed value`:

- the card's pin: `{ type: 'number', expression: 'record.quantity * record.unit_price' }` parses under `SolutionBlueprintSchema` and under `SolutionBlueprintStrictSchema`, and keeps its `expression` in both;
- `FieldSchema` admits the same field as built (a field legal to propose is legal to stage);
- both describes contain `VIRTUAL_FIELD_AGGREGATE_REMEDY` verbatim and no longer say "null for every other field type". The shared tail, from the remedy to the closing absence sentence, is byte-equal across the two (the lockstep pin);
- the stored half of neither describe reads a related record (`record.X.Y`), and neither describe contains a `today()` / `now()` call.

Reverse verification, one-off, not kept. With the describe file restored to `origin/main` (`1216abf1`) and the tests committed, the lockstep / remedy pin went red (`1 failed | 102 passed`). The parse pins stayed green, as expected: the shape already admitted the field. The restore was proven by an empty `git diff HEAD` and a matching HEAD blob hash.

## Acceptance notes

- `#32598` (cloud) waits on this merge sha. Posting it is the seat's job.
- Whether cloud's `apply_blueprint` carries `expression` onto a non-formula field was not measured here. #32598 asks the cloud seat to measure it.
- The published skills (#32635, landed during this PR) say the same remedy in paraphrase, and they also recommend `readonly` on the stored field. The blueprint field has no `readonly` key, so this PR does not teach it.
